increment_paragraph: **CORPUS-GROUP-CHECKPOINTS** (round 21, R8 option D; USER DECISION 2026-11-06, verbatim: "D then A (rec.)", the button being "R8: option D first (per-group checkpoints for the pinned corpus route), then option A (gateway publishes per-unit lookups including missed ones; reuse only for contract-only diffs with matching cross-unit facts). I approve using that lookup record as a reuse input once it is published and checked."): `quirin-audit pinned --checkpoint-dir DIR [--resume]` seals every library group of every phase the pinned corpus route runs (`first`, `refuted`, `imported`) into `DIR/<library>.<stage>.qo` as soon as the group completes and reuses a group only when its whole identity is unchanged: the run inputs (analyzer build, root and revision, source profile and source-contract package files, manifest, locks, pin template, Clang, the QCORE_* environment with the null/outer output paths reduced to `selected` and the link map to its content digest, member facts), the stage's whole-run facts (the exact contract environment with its refutation table and imports, the cross-unit homes, the bounds and null environments) and the group's units (compile record, raw source, preparation digests). The .qo container gains a `Layout` (the pinned layout is schema 1, five sections; each reader refuses the other's files); the whole-run fold is shared and restores stored units one at a time; census, parity, IR, unit-timing, bounds-selection and QCORE_SOURCE_CONTRACTS runs are refused. Lean QCore.StagedCheckpoints (6 theorems) proves staged reuse and that the staged checkpointed run is the whole run. Evidence: E. Fixtures: a changed input of each kind invalidates exactly the groups that read it. No analyzer, contract or verdict change; no measurement. Report: docs/reports/corpus-group-checkpoints/README.md.

ledger.title: R8 option A: reuse units across revisions behind the published per-unit lookup record
ledger.text: Registered by CORPUS-GROUP-CHECKPOINTS (docs/reports/corpus-group-checkpoints/README.md section 6; USER DECISION 2026-11-06, verbatim: "D then A (rec.)", the button being "R8: option D first (per-group checkpoints for the pinned corpus route), then option A (gateway publishes per-unit lookups including missed ones; reuse only for contract-only diffs with matching cross-unit facts). I approve using that lookup record as a reuse input once it is published and checked."). The gateway publishes per unit every name looked up (found and missed), the relied callback candidates and a whole-map-read flag; then the pinned group identity's stage.environment_sha256 (today the whole contract environment) becomes the digest of the environment restricted to the group's units' closures (with include/inherit resolution), plus the refutation entries and homes meeting it, and the analyzer build is accepted from the base side only for a diff confined to contract data (providers/*/contracts/**, their locks, contract/**), recorded in the reuse decision; everything else in the identity stays. DISCHARGE: a contract-only card's measurement reuses unaffected groups (and units on the configured routes), with the composed comparison shown equal to a full run on sampled landings, fail-closed on any unverifiable input.
